reviews.author: Cassandra Ingram
reviews.text: We had a great experience with North GA Electrical Services! They came out to set up electrical for our hot tub and ended up finding some older electrical work that needed to be brought up to code. Instead of just pointing it out, they took care of it for us and made sure everything was safe and done the right way. Philip was always quick to respond to any questions we had from estimate to install. Antonio and his team did an amazing job and besides the work they did, you would have never known they were there. Super professional, honest, and easy to work with. We’re so thankful for their help and would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: M. Evans Howell
reviews.text: Where do I start… I did my due diligence and reviewed Yelp and Google reviews and by far this Company stood out among the others. I called the main office and asked for a quote and was immediately contacted via text message by the owner of the company. He asked me several questions and gave me a not to exceed amount. I asked for a quote over the phone because I am managing my elderly parents in Georgia from my home in Tampa Florida. They sent Antonio out this morning who arrived on time to install a dedicated 20 amp circuit breaker to a through Wall air-conditioning unit. My parents put in the garage to keep their dogs cool in the summer. Antonio and pulled the wire and installed a new outlet and installed the new 20 amp breaker without any drywall damage whatsoever. On another note, I ask Antonio if he would mind doing my elderly parents a favor and changing their air filter for the entire house as I was not gonna be there for another month and I don’t think it had been changed since they bought the house six months ago. He gladly obliged, didn’t even sent me a picture of the old dirty filter once replaced. Now that is going above and beyond! I’ve got these guys on speed dial going forward. I wouldn’t use anyone else in North Georgia. Thank you guys very much!

reviews.author: Courtnie Heller
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience working with Philip for my EV charger installation. He made the entire process incredibly smooth and stress-free from start to finish. One thing that really stood out was how he ensured the charger was set up as a private unit, so only I can use it, which was very important to me. Amazing idea and added protection from Philip! The installation itself was quick, efficient, and done with great attention to detail. On top of that, Philip went above and beyond by helping address a few important electrical issues that needed fixing. His professionalism, knowledge, and genuine care for his clients really shine through in his work. I highly recommend Philip and his company to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality service

reviews.author: Our Home Cassandra
reviews.text: Reliable, Fast & Professional! I spoke with Amber (office) who was very friendly to set up an appointment. Tyler came out the next day to give me a quote & he sent me quote the same day with a fair price & he showed me pictures of the work he had previously done; plus, talked me through the process of my work requested. Tyler & Antonio were great, on time & very friendly. They cleaned up after each electrical installation & didn’t leave a mess behind. They provided installation for 2 garage lights, installed a new pantry light, replaced porch light, replaced old fluorescent lights (primary closet) & installed a new outlet in the primary bathroom. I would absolutely use NGES again & highly recommend! Thanks again Cass!

reviews.author: Andrew Smith
reviews.text: Philip and his team came out today to install a new outdoor wall outlet and mount my 75-inch TV on the back patio, and they completely knocked it out in just a few hours. The quality of their work was top-notch, everything looks clean and professional, and they were respectful, efficient, and detail-oriented from start to finish. Hands down the best customer service experience we’ve ever had with any home service company. I’ll definitely be hiring them again soon to redo all the light fixtures in our home. Highly recommend Philip and his crew to anyone looking for reliable, skilled electricians in Georgia!

reviews.author: Sai Krishna Naripeddi
reviews.text: Excellent and professional work. The electrician did a great job wiring the outdoor camera, installing the Ring doorbell, and setting up four ceiling lights. Everything was completed neatly, on time, and with attention to detail. Highly recommend for any electrical work.

reviews.author: Janet Tarwater
reviews.text: Jacob showed up on time and did a great job. He was very polite and made sure everything was good and working correctly when he was through with the job. Would recommend North Georgia Electrical Services!

reviews.author: Kevin Ritter
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about this company. Needed emergency service, and had originally called a large competitor thinking they would have someone available. Instead of sending an electrician, they sent a coordinator. Called NEGS (after 5pm), and Philip was trying to walk me through possible solutions over the phone in my time of need. I mean c'mon, who does that anymore. After exhausting every avenue, he sent an electrician out first thing in the morning. Tyler and Jacob were ON TIME and got right to work. They troubleshooted, and communicated what was wrong, and the cost, which was a fraction of the larger marketing driven company. The guys were friendly and finished right before my guest arrived. Keeping this company on speed dial for any future issues.

reviews.author: Alexander Wheatley
reviews.text: Philip & his team at North Georgia Electrical Services does great work on all of our projects, their crew is great. Their office manager, Amber is always on point with scheduling. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Niraj Patel
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about North Georgia Electrical Services. They added an outlet to my bathroom, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. The work was done flawlessly, with great attention to detail, and everything was explained clearly along the way. Antonio was an absolute pleasure to work with. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and extremely professional. He clearly took pride in his work and made sure everything was done right. What truly stood out was the company’s commitment to the community. They went above and beyond during the ice storm, showing up when it would have been easy not to. That level of reliability and integrity is rare. I will absolutely continue to use them for any future electrical needs and will recommend them without hesitation. Top-notch work, excellent people, and a company that genuinely cares about the community.

reviews.author: Raymond Rodden
reviews.text: Prompt, professional, knowledgeable, respectful -five star Contacted North Georgia Electrical Services for an estimate concerning the installation of residential whole home surge suppression. Entered an online request and promptly received a phone call to set up an appointment. I was contacted prior to arrival. We discussed several options and the plan was estimated quickly. On site installation was scheduled and confirmed. On the installation day, I received schedule update and again installation tech was prompt, on time and began the installation. Work was completed neatly and documentation left with me. Project cost is extremely fair while using name products. Will use them again should a need arise.

reviews.author: Chelsea P.
reviews.text: I called and spoke to the friendly office manager, Amber, who arranged for someone to help me install a new light fixture in just 30 minutes. Antonio was professional and kind. He did an excellent job with our project.

reviews.author: Kristen Neverlander
reviews.text: It's not everyday you come across a company with as much care for the local cities they serve, nor the willingness to offer assistance in a moments notice as Philip did for our family this week. After a neighborhood power outing, we continued to have a breaker shut off running electricity to our main floor. Needing help as we are in the process of selling our home and notifying Philip of our immediate need, he helped by making suggestions through text message. Informing him that we had appointments for potential buyers coming in the next couple of hours, it was his way of helping in the moment. Following his suggestions, my husband located the bad electrical outlet and was able to replace before our next appointment. Other companies we contacted during the day responded with, "we have no availability today" which Philip could have done as well. However, he chose not to. We are so grateful for people like this still serving our community even if it doesn't yield immediate financial gain. Thank you Philip! Because of your willingness to help in any way possible , we will absolutely use North Georgia Electrical Services for any future needs and share this story with others in our neighborhood to help ensure good people like you and your business are rewarded. Again, Thank you!

reviews.author: benjamin johnson

reviews.text: Philip and Tyler were great! We had some wiring issues that caused some switches to stop working. They were responsive and professional and fixed everything quickly. reviews.author: Kelly Jamieson
reviews.text: These guys are great! Responsive, courteous and most of all human. We had a really old panel and a very dangerous situation. They worked with us on financing and timing to make sure we got it rectified quickly. Will use again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dustin Parker
reviews.text: First and foremost, I would give 10 stars if I could. My wife and I have a large family and about a year ago decided we'd add an additional water heater and a second washer / dryer set to our home. With this, came all new electrical and eventually, electrical problems. It's been about a year since we had a company (NOT North Georgia Electrical Services) install two water heaters and all of the electrical for them and a washer/dryer. Since then, the water heater(s) breaker(s) will randomly throw and we will be left with cold water for 7 of us to shower with. After replacing the breaker once, and being told there is nothing wrong with the water heaters, I decided to call North Georgia Electrical Services for a second opinion on the electrical installations. This was by far the best decision that I have made since deciding to have this stuff installed in the first place. Reed, the company's Project Manager and Electrical Technician, was hands down the most professional, knowledgeable and communicative tradesman that I've had service our home since we purchased it some years ago. He was prompt in returning my initial call, calmed my nerves about what to expect during his visit, and even called an hour prior to arriving to ensure me that he was in fact coming and to provide an ETA. Reed showed up a few minutes early (which I can't complain about!). He listened to my entire story about what led to us calling his company, and immediately began working through the issues. Once he was complete with his investigation of the electrical installations, Reed provided my wife and I with a very understandable set of findings, improvement suggestions and even provided us with some cost-effective solutions to making our home electrical more safe than it is today (best practices are updated annually and he was able to explain exactly what we have and what is industry standard today). To make a long review longer, we will 100% call Reed and North Georgia Electrical Services for ALL of our future electrical needs and will recommend them to all of our friends and family! Reed, thank you for efforts today. Because of you and your attention to our needs, we were able to convince the original installers that it was in fact a faulty water heater and they are replacing it at no cost next week. Gratefully, The Parker Family

reviews.text: I honestly can’t recall another time where I interacted with a company that had a more consultative, professional, and caring approach than NGES. From there, both the tech (Reed) and Phillip were very consultative in the solution, going so far as to recommend us calling the power company because, come to find out, our home was not properly grounded and that was a HUGE risk to my family. Phillip sat with my wife until he felt comfortable with the power company dispatching out a truck and taking care of it. I can’t say enough good things. I’d recommend them to your friends, your family, your enemies, your barber, your favorite barista at your local Starbucks… everyone. Truly fantastic company!

reviews.author: Darren Brown
reviews.text: The breaker on our water heater kept tripping, so after a plumber determined the heater itself was ok, we started looking for an electrician. Not only did he replace the breaker, he found a deficiency that we were not aware of when we bought the house. He was able to return later and now both issues have been repaired. He was professional, quick, and efficient. Hands down, will definitely use for any future problems.
